BEGIN;

CREATE TABLE practice_learning_readiness_receipt (
    id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    task_instance_id uuid NOT NULL,
    student_id uuid NOT NULL,
    task_revision_id uuid NOT NULL,
    route_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES practice_learning_route_resolution(id),
    step_id varchar(128) NOT NULL,
    idempotency_key uuid NOT NULL,
    request_hash varchar(71) NOT NULL CHECK (request_hash ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
    receipt_json jsonb NOT NULL CHECK (
        jsonb_typeof(receipt_json) = 'object'
        AND receipt_json->>'schema' = 'practice-learning-readiness-receipt.v1'
        AND receipt_json->>'id' = id::text
        AND receipt_json->>'task_instance_id' = task_instance_id::text
        AND receipt_json->>'student_id' = student_id::text
        AND receipt_json->>'task_revision_id' = task_revision_id::text
        AND receipt_json->>'route_id' = route_id::text
        AND receipt_json->>'step_id' = step_id
        AND receipt_json->>'decision' IN ('READY', 'NOT_READY')
    ),
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE (task_instance_id, step_id, idempotency_key)
);

CREATE INDEX practice_learning_readiness_step_idx
    ON practice_learning_readiness_receipt(task_instance_id, step_id, created_at DESC);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION protect_practice_learning_readiness_receipt()
RETURNS trigger AS $$
BEGIN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'practice learning readiness receipts are immutable';
    RETURN OLD;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

CREATE TRIGGER trg_protect_practice_learning_readiness_receipt
BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON practice_learning_readiness_receipt
FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION protect_practice_learning_readiness_receipt();

COMMIT;
